name: 77494 · Katy, TX
findings: ZIP 77494 (Katy) has 336 nonprofit organizations. 137 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 105 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77494 (Katy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
